items.label: SUPERONE Advantage
items.value: Leading retractable car charger brand. Our Retractable Car Charger features two 80cm long extendable cables, allowing for easy storage and keeping your car interior clean and organized. No more tangled cables or messy car compartments! Cool gifts for Men/women.

items.label: Upgraded 4-1 Fast Charging Solution
items.value: With a real PD30W type-C retractable cable(Yellow fast charging port), an IOS retractable cable, and additional USB-C and USB-A ports, this fast charge retractable car charger supports fast charging for up to 4 devices simultaneously. Say goodbye to the hassle of carrying multiple chargers for your different devices.【This car charger is only for charging, and cannot be used for CarPlay】

items.label: Voltage Display for Battery Health Monitoring
items.value: Our Car Charger with cord is equipped with a voltage display feature, allowing you to monitor the health of your car battery at all times. Stay informed and ensure optimal performance for your vehicle. Best car/truck accessories for men.

items: This 4 in 1 retractable car phone charger can be used for both 12V DC and 24V DC. Rated Power: 60W. Type-C Retractable Cable Output: PD30W Max. IOS Retractable Cable Output: 5V/2.4A. Type-C Port Output: 5V/3A. USB-A Port Output: 5V/2.4A.

items.label: Safe Usage with All-Round Protections
items.value: 18-Months Warranty. Stable plug with built-in 15A fuse and protective circuits against overcharging, over-temp and short-circuit to safeguard your precious appliances.

items: [Multi-Fast Charging Protocol Certification] The cigarette lighter usb c charger is compatible with devices supporting PD, QC3.0, AFC, MTK, and FCP including phones, tablets, notebooks, Switch, etc. Be like iPhone 17/16/15/14/13/12/11/ Plus/ Pro/ Pro Max/ mini/ XS / XS Max / XR /X /8 Plus/8/ 7 Plus /7 /6S /6, Samsung Galaxy Note 20 Ultra/ Note10 Plus/ S23/S22/S22+/S22 Ultra/S21+/S20/S10 5G /A54/S /S9 Plus/ S8+/ Note 9, Google Pixel7/ 7a/ 6/ 6a/ 5/ 4xl/ 3xl/ 2xl/ 3a/ 4/ 4a/Nexus 6P etc.
